description: This file contains unit tests for the AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer class, which detects conflicting alias attribute values in Orleans-related code constructs such as enums, classes, structs, records, and interfaces. It uses Xunit for testing and verifies the analyzer's behavior in various scenarios including detection of duplicate aliases and non-duplicate cases.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Test class for AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer, containing multiple test methods to verify detection of alias conflicts in Orleans-related code constructs.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method to verify that given code produces diagnostics indicating an alias clash.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method to verify that given code produces no diagnostics, ensuring no false positives.

methods.name: Enum_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on enums triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Record_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on records triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: RecordStruct_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on record structs triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Class_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on classes triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Struct_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on structs triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterface_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Parameterized test to verify that duplicate alias on various grain interface types triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: NonGrainInterface_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate alias on non-grain interfaces does not trigger a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Parameterized test to verify that duplicate method alias within a grain interface triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Parameterized test that ensures differing method aliases within a grain interface do not trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: DifferentGrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test to verify that same method alias in different grain interfaces does not trigger a diagnostic, as aliases are interface-scoped.
